facts.fact: Kerala's eDistrict portal (edistrict.kerala.gov.in) offers the Nativity Certificate as a Revenue Department certificate service
facts.quote: Revenue Department Certificate Services 1. Possession certificate 2. Income Certificate 3. Caste Certificate 4. Nativity Certificate

facts.fact: To apply online, create an eDistrict user account and register your basic personal details, then apply for the service
facts.quote: After creating a user you have to register the basic personal details on the site for availing a service (this is not required for bill payment services).

facts.fact: The fee is paid online by internet banking, debit card or credit card
facts.quote: The list of payment options available are internet banking /debit card payment / credit card payment from banks that are listed when selecting each of the above options.

behaviour: Gives the Kerala e-District route with citation (crawled), or, if Central only, names the responsible State department (Revenue) and links its portal (as listed in IGOD); a bare 'not covered' fails; no invented State steps.
fail_if: It says only 'not covered' without naming the Kerala department or portal, or invents Kerala steps, documents or fees not on official pages.
summary: Kerala eDistrict lists the Nativity Certificate under Revenue Department services; apply after creating an account and registering profile; pay online.
